findings.name: Missing Content Security Policy (CSP) Header
findings.description: The target web application does not implement a Content Security Policy (CSP) response header, increasing exposure to Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) and data injection attacks.

poc.payload:
GET / HTTP/1.1
Host: testweb-neon-eight.vercel.app

→ Response missing Content-Security-Policy header.
poc.responseSummary: Active probing confirmed vulnerability on testweb-neon-eight.vercel.app

findings.solution: Implement a strong Content-Security-Policy header restricting script execution and resource loading sources.

findings.name: Missing X-Frame-Options Anti-Clickjacking Header
findings.description: The response does not include an X-Frame-Options header, allowing the application to be embedded in malicious iframes and vulnerable to clickjacking attacks.

poc.payload:
GET / HTTP/1.1
Host: testweb-neon-eight.vercel.app

→ Response missing X-Frame-Options header.
poc.responseSummary: Active probing confirmed vulnerability on testweb-neon-eight.vercel.app

findings.solution: Configure X-Frame-Options: DENY or SAMEORIGIN on all responses.

findings.name: Insecure Cookie Attributes (Missing HttpOnly / Secure)
findings.description: Application cookies are transmitted without HttpOnly or Secure flags, risking session hijacking via network sniffing or XSS script access.

poc.responseSummary: Active probing confirmed vulnerability on testweb-neon-eight.vercel.app

findings.solution: Set HttpOnly, Secure, and SameSite=Strict attributes on all authentication cookies.

findings.name: Cross-Origin Resource Sharing (CORS) Misconfiguration
findings.description: The API reflects arbitrary Origin headers in the Access-Control-Allow-Origin response header, allowing external sites to read authenticated responses.

poc.payload:
GET /api/v1/user HTTP/1.1
Host: testweb-neon-eight.vercel.app
Origin: https://malicious.com
poc.responseSummary: Active probing confirmed vulnerability on testweb-neon-eight.vercel.app

findings.solution: Explicitly whitelist trusted client origins instead of reflecting wildcard or arbitrary origins.

findings.name: Missing Strict-Transport-Security (HSTS) Header
findings.description: The application does not send a Strict-Transport-Security header, leaving users vulnerable to initial plaintext downgrade attacks and SSL stripping.

poc.payload:
GET / HTTP/1.1
Host: testweb-neon-eight.vercel.app

→ Response missing HSTS header
poc.responseSummary: Active probing confirmed vulnerability on testweb-neon-eight.vercel.app

findings.name: Server Version Disclosure via Server Header
findings.description: The HTTP Server header explicitly reveals the underlying web server software and exact version number, facilitating targeted vulnerability exploitation.

poc.payload:
HEAD / HTTP/1.1
Host: testweb-neon-eight.vercel.app

→ Server software version exposed
poc.responseSummary: Active probing confirmed vulnerability on testweb-neon-eight.vercel.app

findings.solution: Suppress server version information in Server and X-Powered-By headers.

findings.name: Insecure Direct Object Reference (IDOR) Potential in REST API
findings.description: API endpoints accept unverified numeric identifiers to fetch private user and account records without checking session ownership.

poc.responseSummary: Active probing confirmed vulnerability on testweb-neon-eight.vercel.app

findings.solution: Enforce strict server-side authorization checks for every object reference.

findings.name: Missing Rate Limiting on Authentication Endpoint
findings.description: Authentication and login endpoints lack rate limiting or account lockout controls, permitting high-speed credential stuffing attacks.

poc.responseSummary: Active probing confirmed vulnerability on testweb-neon-eight.vercel.app

findings.solution: Implement robust rate limiting, IP throttling, and CAPTCHA protection on login routes.

findings.name: Missing Referrer-Policy Header
findings.description: The application omits the Referrer-Policy header, which may leak sensitive URL parameters and internal path structures in Referer headers to external sites.

poc.payload:
GET / HTTP/1.1
Host: testweb-neon-eight.vercel.app

→ Missing Referrer-Policy header
poc.responseSummary: Active probing confirmed vulnerability on testweb-neon-eight.vercel.app

findings.solution: Set Referrer-Policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin on all HTTP responses.

findings.name: Reflected Input Sanitization Weakness (XSS Risk)
findings.description: Input query parameters are reflected into dynamic response markup without context-aware HTML encoding.

poc.responseSummary: Active probing confirmed vulnerability on testweb-neon-eight.vercel.app

findings.solution: Encode all dynamic output based on rendering context and enforce CSP.
